## What landed

**(1) Declared consolidation, executed — never invented (DF-S1.19-1).**
`RuleAction::ConsolidateMemories` joins the closed `RuleAction` sum
(`crates/hh-hir/src/records.rs`, `crates/hh-hir/src/schema.rs` — CC8
member-add; landed spellings unchanged):
`consolidate_memories{scope, cadence, guards, consolidator,
retention?}`. `hh_context::consolidate::rule_from_action` resolves the
sealed declaration into the `ConsolidationRule` the driver executes —
malformed members fail typed, never silently dropped. The driver's
`consolidation_round` fires eligible rules at the run's durable
boundaries — `session_start` at open (ahead of the first `decide`),
`idle` at finish, `rate_limit` at both — through the new
`MemoryPort::consolidate` leg; an armed rule with no memory boundary
is `UnbackedPort{kind: "consolidate"}`, never a silent skip
(`crates/hh-control/src/driver.rs`).

**(2) `context.memory.consolidated` — the durable watermark (I-FOLD).**
The new audit-grade class registers in the `hh-ledger` class table
(`crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`, hosted lowering `hint`-grade like
its siblings): `{consolidation_id, rule_id, consolidator, scope,
store, lease_generation, cadence, trigger, input_watermark,
last_success_watermark, applied[], skipped_conflicted[],
skipped_no_replacement[], deferred[], usage, retention_policy_ref,
bound, reclaimed, by}` (`crates/hh-context/src/events.rs`). The fold
carries `last_success_watermark` forward so `session_start` never
re-fires across a resume — the durable row *is* the consolidation
state, never a shadow copy.

**(3) `MemoryUsage`-fed reclamation on the landed scheduler (CC1).**
A rule's declared `retention` (`hh_ledger::retention::RetentionPolicy`)
runs the R-2.2 `evaluate_retention` pass over the memory blob pool at
the consolidation boundary; each `lifecycle.ledger.tier_transition`
lands durable before the consolidated row reports `bound`/`reclaimed`
(CC3). No second mechanism.

**(4) `KernelStore::{Local, Remote}` — the coherent mirror.**
`Remote` is `RemoteStore<Box<dyn StoreChannel>>` over the packaged
`hh-memory-store` `plugin_abi/1` channel (`crates/hh-embed/src/
runtime.rs`, `crates/hh-context/src/memory_abi.rs`). Mutations land
on the far side *and* the mirror; retrieval indexes, lifecycle,
usage and stale state all fold the mirror — one truth. The indexed
pipeline stamps reads on the mirror and `forward_read` ships the same
`{version_id, seq}` pair to the far side so `memory_usage` agrees on
both sides — one stamp per side, never double-counted. Channel
divergence is a latched typed `ChannelFault`, never guessed through.

**(5) `by_run` + non-`lexical` indexes (DF-S1.19-1).** The fold's
artifact-layer projection indexes every `context.memory.written` by
run; `by_run{run_id, classes}` and `structural` queries enumerate it
through `retrieve_indexed` over `structural_index` — the same fold
source local and remote.

**(6) Arm-time `ContextPolicy` binding.** `policy_for_variant` resolves
the sealed `context_policy` slot's declared variant
(`default`/`full_window`/`priority_eviction`/`world_state_diff`/
`jit_handles`/`recency_plus_pins`/`retrieval_augmented`; `hh/` +
`context_policy/` spellings, optional `@1`) at `open`/`arm`/`resume`;
an unknown ref refuses typed — never a silent `default` substitution
(`crates/hh-context/src/policy_family.rs`, `crates/hh-embed/src/
open.rs`).

**(7) Fold `content_ref` rehydration.** `KernelContext::fold` takes the
ledger `Store`; a `context.memory.written` row's `content_ref`
resolves through `Store::get_blob` — JSON bytes →
`MemoryContent::Structured`, else `Text`. A missing or unreadable
blob leaves an honest skeleton (identity + provenance, empty body) —
never fabricated text. Rebind-generated `written` rows preserve the
source `content_ref`, so a duplicate row can never downgrade a body.

**(8) `ContextWindowExceeded → stop` (DF-S1.19-2 + ADR-0254 d6).**
`AssembledRequest.overflow: Option<CompactionRequired>` carries the
builder's typed overflow; `stage01_disposition` maps it to
`Stop{CompactionRequired}`; the driver stops
`context_exhausted{required_tokens, cap}` — the closed spelling on
`control.decision`/`lifecycle.run.finished` — with the overflow
durable on the `context.assembled` row first. No model call fires on
an overflowed plan; the kernel-reserved omission item counts toward
the requirement (never a user omission).

**Battery legs (DF-S1.19-2), all over the real port:** golden-plan
determinism across repeated assembly over durable
`context.observation.recorded`; a 48-candidate stress with
deterministic optional eviction + full accounting (the reserved
`mc-s:omission` item excluded from user-candidate closure); per-slot
occupancy projected from the durable `context.assembled` item rows
and reconciled with the plan's occupancy table — projections of what
was written, never estimates.

**Regression updates.** `hh-control/tests/{r2_5,r3_3,s3_10}.rs`,
`hh-orchestrator/tests/r3_3.rs`, `hh-bench/tests/s3_12b.rs`,
`hh-context/tests/s4_16b.rs` — the `AssembledRequest.overflow` field
on every assembler constructor + consolidation fakes; no suite
rewritten.
